title: Camera offline
summary: Camera shows as offline or no video in the recorder or VMS.
symptoms: No live video from one camera
Camera shows offline in the NVR or VMS
Camera not found on the network

outline.title: Check whether one camera or several are affected
outline.detail: Several cameras offline together points to a switch, NVR or network fault rather than the camera.

outline.title: Confirm the camera is powered
outline.detail: Check the PoE status on the switch or NVR port, or the DC supply if used.

outline.title: Check the network link
outline.detail: Check the port link light, then patch leads and cable termination.

outline.title: Confirm the camera's network settings
outline.detail: Compare the camera's IP settings with what the recorder expects.

outline.title: Check recorder configuration and credentials
outline.detail: A changed camera password or IP address will stop the recorder connecting.

verification.notes: Demonstration workflow outline. General fault-finding order only — follow the manufacturer's documentation and site procedures.
